Mermaid Test

```{r}
#| label: fig-mermaid
#| fig-cap: "Testing the Mermaid flowchart function."


library(DiagrammeR)
library(quarto)

mermaid(diagram="
graph LR;
  A[Are coordinates in<br>the datatable?]
  B(Copy & paste<br>from Google Maps)
  D[Are values in<br>a decimal format?]
  E(Run <i>parse</i> function)
  F[Are lat & lon column<br>names in lower case?]
  G(Use <i>dplyr</i> to<br>rename columns)
  H(Datatable is<br>ready to use)
    A-- yes -->D
    A-- no -->B
    B-->D
    D-- yes -->F
    D-- no -->E
    E-->F
    F-- no -->G
    F-- yes -->H
    G-->H")

```

```{mermaid}

mermaid(diagram="
  graph LR
  
  A[datatable]
  B[basemap]
  C[map render]
  D(data: text, lon, lat)
  J(style columns)
  E(site_google_basemap)
  F(ggmap)
  G(site_points)
  H(site_labels)
  %% style A fill:#2c2,stroke:#000,stroke-width:4px
  %% style B fill:#2c2,stroke:#000,stroke-width:4px
  %% style C fill:#2c2,stroke:#000,stroke-width:4px
  subgraph Basic Steps
  A ==> E
  B ==> F
  D -.-> A
  E -.-> B
  J -.-> A
  F -.-> C
  G -.-> C
  H -.-> C
  A ==> G
  A ==> H
  end")

```
